s1.syndrome_frame: febrile illness with rash and hypotension in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: erythematous patches and thin plaques with telangiectases and hyperpigmentation
intravascular atypical cells on skin biopsy
key_facts: patient is a woman in her 50s
history of chronic pulmonary coccidiomycosis
being treated with fluconazole
admitted for fever, hypotension, and rash
previous reaction to pembrolizumab
new skin eruption is widespread and asymptomatic
skin eruption has been ongoing for 1 to 2 weeks
white blood cell count is 4100/μL
absolute neutrophil count is 2940/μL
hemoglobin level is 8.2 g/dL
platelet count is 62 ×10^3/μL
blood culture results show no growth at 1 week
serum β-D-glucan, galactomannan, Coccidioides antibody, and immunodiffusion results are negative
respiratory viral panel and SARS-CoV-2 test results are negative
